purpose: Teach: 小田/富田/天野/遠山/篠原/藤村/須藤/牧野

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、小田氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were young, you started a joint venture with Oda, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle, measured opening. Soft inquiry—not interrogation. A man revisiting quiet pride in someone else's accomplishments. Warm, almost tender pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは富田先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. My father received great guidance from my senior, Tomita.
lines.style: Steady, respectful acknowledgment. Clear articulation of the name. A slight pause before the mentor's name—honoring the weight of that influence. Calm certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、天野氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: And when you were young, you planned overseas expansion with Amano.
lines.style: Same gentle, measuring tone. A patient return to memory. Slight lift at the end—inviting confirmation, not demanding it. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは遠山氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. My father made Toyama the cornerstone of our public relations.
lines.style: Reflective, thoughtful. A small pause before the name—placing value on the decision itself. Quiet conviction. Not boasting; accounting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、篠原氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: And in those days, you established the accounting structure with Shinohara.
lines.style: Same gentle inquiry. A slight weariness underneath—the accumulated weight of memory. Still warm. Trailing softly into the name, as if inviting its echo.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは藤村氏を主任として育てられた
lines.en: Yes. My father developed Fujimura into a department head.
lines.style: Steady, measured. The faintest pride in the phrasing—not self-pride, but satisfaction in having seen someone grow. Clear, calm. A man honoring his own father through careful memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、須藤氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: And you established the overseas subsidiary with Sudo in those years.
lines.style: Same patient, wistful cadence. A man reaching back through time with care. Slight breathiness on the name—as if it carries its own weight. Unhurried, almost reverent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは牧野氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. My father entrusted all legal matters to Makino.
lines.style: Closing reflection—a man drawing his story to a gentle close. Clear, unhurried. A final acknowledgment of trust given and honored. Composed finality without heaviness.
